summary: A Strategy/Ring played from hand whose Attack opens the attackReaction window is now discarded as the window opens. ExecuteAbilityEffects became a thin wrapper around RunAbilityEffects (the old body); it spends the hand-played card when this call left a new PendingAttack. Covers every Attack case (Strength of the Divine, False Ring of Water, future Strategic Strike) with no per-case edits. Shared SpendHandPlayedCard helper is also used by the unchanged immediate-path tail. ResolveAttack and PendingAttack.Additional bookkeeping are untouched. No published content added.
validation: Regression HandPlayedAttackSpentWhenWindowOpens (Strength of the Divine + False Ring of Water: window open/closed/negated, no-window unchanged, Additional Action grant bookkeeping identical with and without a window). Failed on unfixed main (expected FateDiscard; got Hand, 200/201). Two mutations caught it (Ring dropped from helper; ResolveAttack Additional guard removed). bash tools/check.sh --skip-client: exit 0; 201/201 core, 57/57 published, 14/14 ai, 5/5 transport, python 43+130 OK. Automated tests only; not expert rules acceptance.
remaining: Rules judgment for Mendon: core rules step G discards after resolution, but the engine has no resolving zone, so the card is in the discard pile while the window is open (follows Dueling's discard-at-play precedent). Separate, unfixed, out of scope, found by code reading and NOT tested: an Attack deferred behind the window returns before the rest of RunAbilityEffects' tail, and ResolveAttack only calls NextAction, so the post-action bow/move/Nikutai reaction windows, the Law of Darkness Honor-loss check and (for a future Discipline Attack) removal from game do not run for it; PassReaction's Overconfident check runs at window close, before the Attack resolves. Worth a follow-up issue. Strategic Strike (oracle-l5r-7525) remains unwired; this unblocks it. Not merged.
